key_insight: The neural basis method separates fixed neural representations from physics-based coefficient determination to solve and learn Navier–Stokes dynamics.
engineering_relevance: Shared basis coordinates can make parametric flow prediction more scalable by learning parameter-to-coefficient maps rather than spatially dependent solution maps.
method: Represent flow solutions with fixed neural bases.
Project governing equations to determine expansion coefficients.
For incompressible flow, use a velocity-only residual that provides an a posteriori velocity-error estimate for data-free coefficient learning.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical analysis and numerical experiments showing improvements over baselines in accuracy, efficiency, generalization, and scalability, but gives no quantitative results.
watch_item: Practical performance depends on whether the fixed neural basis adequately represents the target flow regimes.
paper_title: Solving and Learning Navier-Stokes Dynamics with the Neural Basis Method
